scope: Controller parameters only. Simulator inertia, force model, gates, clocks, stable-hover criteria and race acceptance remain unchanged. Profiles are hypotheses, not validated flight improvements.

observed_rate_limit.hypothesis: Match feedforward rate to the observed approximately 7 rad/s actual-rate plateau; avoid requesting an unavailable reference-rate component.

damped_turns.hypothesis: Slightly faster nominal-rate filtering and greater angular-rate damping may reduce reversal overshoot without increasing position or attitude stiffness.

large_angle_log.hypothesis: Existing SO(3) log error avoids the sine error weakening near large attitude discrepancies; reduced stiffness limits additional torque demand. This may still be worse under sampled-state feedback.

bounded_angular_acceleration.hypothesis: Small bounded angular-acceleration feedforward may anticipate braking and reversal. Its second numerical derivative makes this lower priority than route shaping.

recommended_comparison: Run original prehover 1.20 first with each profile, compare gate offsets, axis error, saturation and repeated pass rate; only then combine the best unchanged-control candidate with new geometry and increase speed.
